title: mcp/list_registrations/v1
description: The result of the list_registrations tool (F25-T4, R15; D-3, D-10, D-28 v3.37): every registration of a target in a public registry as the products derive it from the target's registration records (registrations.derive) and publish it on targets/index.json's rows (targets-index/v10), each row with its target_id, in the index's order: nothing is ranked (D-25) and nothing is recorded. An index rendered before v10 carries the field on no row, so it lists none. Every value is an identifier, an enum or a url built from validated records; no contributor prose is served, so nothing is demarcated. Or an error result naming the source that did not answer, or the filter refused (R10).

read_at.description: The commit of main the graph was read at, or the branch name when the service could not learn its head (F05-T13).

target_id.description: The target filter as given; null for every target.

registry_id.description: The registry's id once issued; null while a submission has none.

version.description: The registry's version of the record; null before registration.

status.description: As the registry last answered; a withdrawn registration is not listed.

url.description: The registry's page for the entry once registered; null before.

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
